newsitem.title: USA: Tupperware Corp files to issue securities.
newsitem.headline: Tupperware Corp files to issue securities.

text.p: Tupperware Corp said Tuesday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf-registration statement that allows it to issue up to $200 million in debt securities.
After the registration statement becomes effective, a subsidiary of Tupperware may offer debt securities from time to time, up to a maximum of $200 million principal amount.

Proceeds from the securities would be used for general corporate purposes, including the refinancing of short-term debt incurred as a result of its spin-off from Premark International Inc earlier this year, the company said.
